The schedule is unique, and it matches my earlier answer.

Hana, Dev and Elif must occupy consecutive slots h, h+1, h+2, since Hana < Dev < Elif and Elif is two slots after Hana. Ann is then at h−1 or h+3. Ann at h−1 forces Finn before Elif, which is impossible. So Ann is at h+3. Cara is at h+1 or h+5, and h+1 is taken by Dev, so Cara is at h+5. That puts Finn at h+4 and Gus at h+6, since Gus at h+2 is taken. Ivo and Ben must both come before Gus, and the only free slots before h are needed for them, which forces h=3. That places Ivo and Ben in slots 1 and 2, with Ivo first.

All 13 constraints check out against this schedule. Ann (6) and Ben (2) are four apart, and Elif (5) and Gus (9) are four apart.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ivo","2":"Ben","3":"Hana","4":"Dev","5":"Elif","6":"Ann","7":"Finn","8":"Cara","9":"Gus"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
